notes: UnlockToken (src/UnlockToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin v5.0.2 ERC20: name UNLOCK, symbol UNLK, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 UNLK (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the factory on launch. There is no owner, minter, pause, blacklist, freeze, burn, tax, rebase, upgrade or proxy; every transfer delivers the exact amount, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided pool seed through the PoolManager and later claims and swaps move exactly what they say. The launch deploys no application contracts and needs no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 on Ethereum at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
